summary: Kidoz Inc., a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a notice of annual general meeting, a management information circular dated October 6, 2026, and related proxy materials. The AGM is scheduled for November 24, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, both in person and by webcast. Shareholders of record as of October 6, 2026, will vote on receiving audited FY2025 financials, fixing the board at six directors, electing six directors, appointing Davidson Company LLP as auditors, and ratifying a 10% rolling stock option plan. No special-situation event, transaction terms, or advisor is disclosed; this is routine meeting and proxy solicitation material.
